During Q2, Elenger continued developing battery energy storage systems, with a 4.5 MW facility in Liepāja, Latvia entering commercial operation at the start of Q3 2026. Polish subsidiaries secured a EUR 60 million loan agreement to expand the Polish gas business.

The summary explains this apparent contradiction through specific operational improvements (supporting businesses turnaround, new biomethane plant) and strategic actions. All statements logically support each other without contradictions. The organization flows logically from overall performance to segment details to strategic actions and balance sheet strength. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between statements are clear and logically connected.
